name: 天照
description: 将5格内1个格子周围的3×3区域永久标记为天照范围。棋子经过或停留在天照格上时会叠加天照，每层天照会在回合结束时使其失去2点生命。
code: function executeSkill(context) { var caster = context.piece; var battle = context.battle; var center = selectTarget({ type: 'grid', range: 5, filter: 'all' }); if (!center || center.needsTargetSelection) return center; if (!battle.extensions) battle.extensions = {}; if (!battle.extensions.tileEffects) battle.extensions.tileEffects = []; if (!battle.extensions.amaterasuCells) battle.extensions.amaterasuCells = []; var added = 0; for (var dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++) { for (var dy = -1; dy <= 1; dy++) { var cx = center.x + dx; var cy = center.y + dy; var tile = battle.map && battle.map.tiles && battle.map.tiles.find(function(t) { return t.x === cx && t.y === cy; }); if (!tile) continue; if (!battle.extensions.tileEffects.some(function(t) { return t.tileType === 'amaterasu' && t.x === cx && t.y === cy; })) { battle.extensions.tileEffects.push({ x: cx, y: cy, sourceId: 'amaterasu', tileType: 'amaterasu', icon: '🌑', iconPosition: 'bottom-right' }); added++; } if (!battle.extensions.amaterasuCells.some(function(c) { return c.x === cx && c.y === cy; })) { battle.extensions.amaterasuCells.push({ x: cx, y: cy }); } } } battle.extensions.amaterasuOwnerPlayerId = caster.ownerPlayerId; addPlayerRuleById(caster.ownerPlayerId, 'rule-sasuke-amaterasu-move'); addPlayerRuleById(caster.ownerPlayerId, 'rule-sasuke-amaterasu-stack'); addPlayerRuleById(caster.ownerPlayerId, 'rule-sasuke-amaterasu-damage'); return { success: true, message: caster.name + '释放天照，以(' + center.x + ',' + center.y + ')为中心标记了' + added + '个格子为永久天照范围！凡踏入者将遭受黑炎灼烧' }; }
